gate_definition: SEMANTIC -- classification, population, source meaning, relation meaning (data/staging/integration/wave3_eligibility.json)
determinism_note: Every check is a total pass over the population -- no sample, no seed, no model call. Re-running it on the same rows and the same graph gives the same artifact byte for byte apart from the timestamp.

population_under_test.out_of_scope_reason: OWNER_DECISION_G_GANA_OBJECT_OUT_OF_V1 places the object-side Gana model outside Product V1. The 332 GANA_RENDERING rows and the 3 container-scope performance rows stay staged and are not adjudicated for import here. They are not averaged into any figure above: a file holding two kinds of claim has no single pass rate.

pass_condition: Every check reports zero failures AND full coverage of its own eligible population. A check below full coverage fails the GATE, not the data.

checks.name: classification.source_explicit_is_earned_not_asserted
checks.asks: Every row calls itself SOURCE_EXPLICIT. Does each one actually carry a mark the source supplied, rather than a mark this pipeline could have inferred?

checks.name: classification.not_importable_vocabulary_is_absent
checks.asks: The campaign forbids importing a PROBABLE or UNVERIFIED row. Does any field of any row carry either word?

checks.name: classification.notation_is_not_audio
checks.asks: OWNER_DECISION_F rules the audible gate covers audio only. Does any notation row borrow audio vocabulary or claim aural verification?

checks.name: classification.marks_are_recorded_not_interpreted
checks.asks: Is the payload field space the declared closed set, and does nothing in it name a pitch, a svara name or a decipherment the project does not hold?

checks.name: population.every_samavedic_verse_carries_one_typed_disposition
checks.asks: Completeness here is a truthful disposition per verse, not universal coverage. Do the notated and the withheld partition the 1,844 exactly once each?

checks.name: population.coverage_is_reported_per_collection_not_only_as_a_total
checks.asks: A 1,136 total hides which arcika a reader can and cannot see notation for. Does every collection's notated count sit inside its own denominator?

checks.name: population.withheld_absence_is_typed_in_the_row
checks.asks: A withheld verse must say WHY in its own row. Does each of the 708 carry a reason from the closed set, and are the two kinds of absence kept apart?

observed.note: A withheld row is not a rejection. 599 are a witness disagreement that needs philological adjudication and 109 are a probable absence from this witness; neither is a statement that the verse has no notation in the tradition.

checks.name: source.every_row_cites_one_pinned_revision_of_one_page
checks.asks: A witness that moved mid-harvest would make the 1,136 a mixture of two texts. Do all rows cite the same page_id and revid, and is every line cited once?

checks.name: source.the_witness_is_labelled_what_it_is
checks.asks: This is a community transcription, not a critical edition. Does the source record say so, carry a licence, and does every row inherit that quality class?

observed.what_this_is_not: Not a critical edition and not a school-certified notation. It is one pinned revision of a community transcription that prints the Kauthuma numeric svara marks, and it must be presented as a witness rather than as the text.

checks.name: source.the_recension_claim_is_about_this_witness
checks.asks: A notation from another school laid over Kauthuma verses would be wrong in a way no count could show. Does every row carry the recension finding, and does the finding name what it excludes?

checks.name: relation.the_row_asks_for_a_text_witness_not_a_melodic_object
checks.asks: Owner decision G places the object-side Gana model outside Product V1. Does any notation row ask for MUSICALIZED_AS, a Gana node, or any object this graph has no canonical identity for?

observed.what_the_row_is: A second, accented WITNESS of a verse's own text. The claim is textual: this source prints these marks on this verse. It is not a claim that the verse is sung as any named saman, which would need an object side this corpus excludes.

checks.name: relation.the_subject_grain_is_the_verse
checks.asks: Notation printed on a verse belongs to that verse. Does every key resolve to a verse-grained Mantra rather than to a container?
